The Tiki Totem was introduced in desktop patch 1.2, according to the History section of the Terraria Wiki's Tiki Totem page. That contradicts the team note saying 1.3, and I could not find a source supporting 1.3. My earlier answer missed this because I only checked the Tiki and Desktop pages, not the Tiki Totem page itself.

CONFIDENCE: 80
